full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 97
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Tuesday, Jestha 19, 2083
1:00 PM
1. Letter from the Office of the President
The Honorable Speaker will read out the letter received from the Office of the President regarding the certification of bills.
2. Discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure Begins
Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle will present the motion 'Let the general discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure for FY 2083/084 begin' with a statement.
3. General Discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure for FY 2083/084 Begins.
Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The Speaker will read a letter from the Office of the President concerning the certification of bills. This marks the formal commencement of the day's proceedings.

speakers.name: Honorable Speaker
speakers.topic: Reading letter from the Office of the President

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The Finance Minister presented a motion to begin a general discussion on the Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure for FY 2083/084. Following this, the general discussion on the budget commenced.
key_issues: Annual Estimate of Revenue and Expenditure
